records.question: 工单260600002的整体RTY是多少？
records.sql:
WITH fpy AS (
  SELECT process_id,
         good_panels * 1.0 / input_panels AS f
  FROM fact_process_record
  WHERE lot_id = '260600002'
    AND is_rework_pass = 0
)
SELECT '260600002' AS lot_id,
       (SELECT lot_status FROM fact_work_order WHERE lot_id = '260600002') AS lot_status,
       ROUND(
         MAX(CASE WHEN process_id='P01' THEN f END) * MAX(CASE WHEN process_id='P02' THEN f END)
       * MAX(CASE WHEN process_id='P03' THEN f END) * MAX(CASE WHEN process_id='P04' THEN f END)
       * MAX(CASE WHEN process_id='P05' THEN f END) * MAX(CASE WHEN process_id='P06' THEN f END)
       * MAX(CASE WHEN process_id='P07' THEN f END) * MAX(CASE WHEN process_id='P08' THEN f END)
       * MAX(CASE WHEN process_id='P09' THEN f END) * MAX(CASE WHEN process_id='P10' THEN f END)
       * MAX(CASE WHEN process_id='P11' THEN f END) * MAX(CASE WHEN process_id='P12' THEN f END)
       * MAX(CASE WHEN process_id='P13' THEN f END) * MAX(CASE WHEN process_id='P14' THEN f END)
       * MAX(CASE WHEN process_id='P15' THEN f END) * MAX(CASE WHEN process_id='P16' THEN f END)
       * MAX(CASE WHEN process_id='P17' THEN f END), 4) AS rty
FROM fpy
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT process_id) = 17

records.question: 全部已完工批次的整体RTY平均值和中位数是多少？
records.sql:
WITH fpy AS (
  SELECT p.lot_id,
         p.process_id,
         p.good_panels * 1.0 / p.input_panels AS f
  FROM fact_process_record p
  JOIN fact_work_order w ON w.lot_id = p.lot_id
  WHERE w.lot_status = '已完工'
    AND p.is_rework_pass = 0
),
lot_rty AS (
  SELECT lot_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN process_id='P01' THEN f END) * MAX(CASE WHEN process_id='P02' THEN f END)
       * MAX(CASE WHEN process_id='P03' THEN f END) * MAX(CASE WHEN process_id='P04' THEN f END)
       * MAX(CASE WHEN process_id='P05' THEN f END) * MAX(CASE WHEN process_id='P06' THEN f END)
       * MAX(CASE WHEN process_id='P07' THEN f END) * MAX(CASE WHEN process_id='P08' THEN f END)
       * MAX(CASE WHEN process_id='P09' THEN f END) * MAX(CASE WHEN process_id='P10' THEN f END)
       * MAX(CASE WHEN process_id='P11' THEN f END) * MAX(CASE WHEN process_id='P12' THEN f END)
       * MAX(CASE WHEN process_id='P13' THEN f END) * MAX(CASE WHEN process_id='P14' THEN f END)
       * MAX(CASE WHEN process_id='P15' THEN f END) * MAX(CASE WHEN process_id='P16' THEN f END)
       * MAX(CASE WHEN process_id='P17' THEN f END) AS rty
  FROM fpy
  GROUP BY lot_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT process_id) = 17
),
ordered AS (
  SELECT rty,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY rty) AS rn,
         COUNT(*) OVER () AS n
  FROM lot_rty
),
mid AS (
  SELECT rty FROM ordered WHERE rn IN ((n + 1) / 2, (n + 2) / 2)
)
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lot_rty) AS lot_cnt,
       ROUND((SELECT AVG(rty) FROM lot_rty), 4) AS avg_rty,
       ROUND(AVG(mid.rty), 4) AS median_rty
FROM mid

records.question: FCBGA和FCCSP两类产品的RTY分别是多少？
records.sql:
WITH fpy AS (
  SELECT p.lot_id,
         p.process_id,
         p.good_panels * 1.0 / p.input_panels AS f
  FROM fact_process_record p
  JOIN fact_work_order w ON w.lot_id = p.lot_id
  WHERE w.lot_status = '已完工'
    AND p.is_rework_pass = 0
),
lot_rty AS (
  SELECT lot_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN process_id='P01' THEN f END) * MAX(CASE WHEN process_id='P02' THEN f END)
       * MAX(CASE WHEN process_id='P03' THEN f END) * MAX(CASE WHEN process_id='P04' THEN f END)
       * MAX(CASE WHEN process_id='P05' THEN f END) * MAX(CASE WHEN process_id='P06' THEN f END)
       * MAX(CASE WHEN process_id='P07' THEN f END) * MAX(CASE WHEN process_id='P08' THEN f END)
       * MAX(CASE WHEN process_id='P09' THEN f END) * MAX(CASE WHEN process_id='P10' THEN f END)
       * MAX(CASE WHEN process_id='P11' THEN f END) * MAX(CASE WHEN process_id='P12' THEN f END)
       * MAX(CASE WHEN process_id='P13' THEN f END) * MAX(CASE WHEN process_id='P14' THEN f END)
       * MAX(CASE WHEN process_id='P15' THEN f END) * MAX(CASE WHEN process_id='P16' THEN f END)
       * MAX(CASE WHEN process_id='P17' THEN f END) AS rty
  FROM fpy
  GROUP BY lot_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT process_id) = 17
)
SELECT pr.product_type,
       COUNT(*) AS lot_cnt,

records.question: 本月的准时交付率是多少？
records.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS ship_cnt,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.ship_date <= d.due_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS on_time_cnt,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN s.ship_date <= d.due_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS otd
FROM fact_shipment s
JOIN (
  SELECT order_id, MIN(due_date) AS due_date
  FROM fact_sales_order_item
  GROUP BY order_id
) d ON d.order_id = s.order_id
WHERE s.ship_date >= date('2026-09-24', 'start of month')

records.question: 按2026-09-24快照，未结清应收账款的未到期余额和逾期金额分别是多少？
records.sql:
SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN x.due_date >= '2026-09-24' THEN x.bal ELSE 0 END), 2) AS 未到期余额,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN x.due_date <  '2026-09-24' THEN x.bal ELSE 0 END), 2) AS 逾期金额,
  COUNT(*) AS 未结清笔数
FROM (
  SELECT r.due_date,
         r.amount - r.received_amount AS bal
  FROM fact_receivable r
  WHERE r.status IN ('部分','未收')
) x

FROM fact_receivable

records.question: 已经结清的应收账款有多少笔？
records.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS settled_bills,
       ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS settled_amount
FROM fact_receivable
WHERE status = '已结清'

records.question: 设备故障导致的停机有多少次、共多少分钟？
records.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS 故障停机次数,
       SUM(duration_min) AS 故障停机总分钟
FROM fact_equipment_downtime
WHERE reason = '故障'

records.question: 夜班一共产生了多少条过站记录？
records.sql:
SELECT s.shift_name AS 班次,
       COUNT(*) AS 过站记录数
FROM fact_process_record p
JOIN dim_shift s ON s.shift_id = p.shift_id
WHERE s.shift_name = '夜班'
GROUP BY s.shift_name

records.question: 当前处于维修状态的设备有几台？
records.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS 维修中设备台数
FROM dim_equipment
WHERE status = '维修'

records.question: 客户客诉总共有多少起？
records.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS complaint_cnt
FROM fact_customer_complaint

records.question: DPPM最高的一次客诉是哪个客户、多少DPPM？
records.sql:
SELECT c.customer_id,
       c.customer_name,
       x.complaint_id,
       x.complaint_date,
       x.dppm
FROM fact_customer_complaint x
JOIN dim_customer c ON c.customer_id = x.customer_id
ORDER BY x.dppm DESC
LIMIT 1

records.question: 成品库存总共有多少颗？
records.sql:
SELECT '成品' AS stock_type,
       SUM(qty_on_hand) AS qty_on_hand
FROM fact_inventory
WHERE stock_type = '成品'

records.question: 全部原料的库存总金额是多少？
records.sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(i.qty_on_hand * COALESCE(m.standard_cost, 0)), 2) AS 原料库存总金额
FROM fact_inventory i
JOIN dim_material m ON m.material_id = i.material_id
WHERE i.stock_type = '原料'

records.question: AOI检出的缺陷总数量是多少？
records.sql:
SELECT SUM(defect_qty) AS aoi_defect_qty
FROM fact_defect
WHERE detect_method = 'AOI'
